Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: A project inquiry submitted through the CATALYS public contact form and managed privately by studio admins.

referenceId.description: Unique human-readable studio inquiry reference ID.

name.description: Full name of the prospective client.

email.description: Contact email address of the sender.

phone.description: Optional contact phone number provided by the sender.

reason.description: Selected project scope or inquiry category.

details.description: Project brief, goals, and timeline shared by the sender.

status.description: Workflow triage status of the inquiry.

createdAt.description: Server-generated Firestore timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized CATALYS studio administrator marker document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Publicly submittable (write-only), admin-managed collection of client project inquiries.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Server/console-managed administrator allowlist keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
